name: Kantone Holdings Limited
summary: Kantone Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, sells and leases system products, software licensing and customisation businesses in the United Kingdom, Germany, the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and Macau. It researches, develops, and trades in cultural products; designs, manufactures, and distributes communication systems and equipment. In addition, the company offers installation and maintenance services. Kantone Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
